ios.desc:
Use your phone as a webcam for your Mac.
Easy to use and completely free!

Features:

- 4K 2160p, Full HD 1080p, 720p and 480p.
- Up to 60 FPS.
- Low latency.
- Use any camera lens on your phone.
- Focus, Exposure and Torch controls.
- Stream via USB.
- Control via Mac’s Menu Bar.

This app requires the installation of a Mac companion app and camera plugin, both compatible with macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) and later.

Webcam Plus supports many apps, such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Zoom, OBS, and more. Please check app availability list on our website.

For more details and instructions, visit: 
https://webcamplus.app

quotes.text:
Hello,

I want to show an app that I have been working on as a hobby project. It has been in beta testing since December, but now it is finally released.

This may not be the most original idea ever, but it is completely free to use, so I hope some of you will find it useful!

- Supports Full HD 1080p, 720p and 480p
- Up to 30 FPS
- Stream via USB

My goal has been to keep it very minimalistic and easy-to-use.

I also want to mention right away that it installs as a DAL Plugin on your mac, meaning that it will only work on apps that allows third party plugins.

More info on my webpage: https://webcamplus.app

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/webcam-plus/id1546556174
